problem.help: The problem statement: what deviates, where, and by how much.

images.help: Images that delimit the problem: what belongs to it and what does not, each with a caption. The image data appears only as a size.

inScope.help: The defect images that show the problem.

outScope.help: The images that explicitly do not belong to the problem.

experts.help: The expert team: every member rates every cause from 0 to 9.

id.help: The id of the member; value for expertId and key of the ratings.

name.help: The name of the member; it must differ from the others, ignoring case.

color.help: The colour of the member as a hex value; it is assigned in turn when the member is added.

catLabels.help: Custom names of the six categories, each under its key; empty means the default name.

rows.help: The cause tree: main and sub-causes with identifier, category, name, description, status and the ratings of each member of the expert team.

id.help: The id of the cause; value for rowId, parentId and targetRowId.

stableId.help: The identifier of the cause (H-001 …); it stays the same across snapshots and links causes to experiments.

parentId.help: The id of the parent cause; null for a main cause.

category.help: The 6M category of a main cause: man, machine, environment, material, measurement, method; empty for a sub-cause, which inherits the category of its main cause.

description.help: What the cause is and why it is suspected.

ratings.help: The ratings: member id → integer from 0 (unlikely) to 9 (very likely). A member without an entry has not rated.

status.help: How far the check has come: open, testing, confirmed or rejected.

avgScore.help: Mean of the ratings of all members of the expert team, from 0 to 9; while comparing with a snapshot, the change stands beside it.

snapshots.help: Saved states with name and time. Their content appears only as a size; the comparison shows what has changed.

id.help: The id of the snapshot; value for snapshotId.

date.help: The time at which the snapshot was saved.

data.help: The saved state of problem statement, expert team and cause tree; read only as a size.

experiments.help: The experiments with title, description, responsible, status, period, cost and the causes they check.

id.help: The id of the experiment; value for experimentId.

description.help: What is tried and how the result is measured.

status.help: Where the experiment stands: planned, running, done or cancelled.

startDate.help: First day of the experiment as YYYY-MM-DD or empty.

endDate.help: Last day of the experiment as YYYY-MM-DD or empty.

costMoney.help: Money spent in euros; null if not given.

costHours.help: Effort in hours; null if not given.

hypothesisIds.help: The identifiers (stableId) of the causes the experiment checks, such as H-001.

gantt.help: Schedule of the experiments from start to end; the line marks today.

cost.help: Cost in euros and effort in hours of all experiments, summed up over time.

costRate.help: Cost in euros and effort in hours per day, spread over the duration of the experiments.

facts.help: The facts: observations with name, description, date and who reported them.

id.help: The id of the fact; value for factId.

description.help: Details and source of the observation.

date.help: When it was observed, as YYYY-MM-DD or empty.

paretoEdits.help: The editor settings of the Pareto chart (axes, threshold, bars, line); they are saved with the module.

scores.help: The score of each cause under its identifier: mean of the ratings given, from 0 to 9; null while nobody has rated.

paretoItems.help: The rated causes in descending order of score, each with identifier, name, effective category and score; sub-causes appear in the category of their main cause.

read.help: Read problem statement, images, expert team, cause tree with ratings, snapshots, experiments and facts. Image data and snapshot content appear only as a size.

addExpert.help: Add a member to the expert team. Every member rates every cause from 0 to 9. Returns the id.

params.name: The name; it must differ from the others, ignoring case. An empty name is an error.

renameExpert.help: Rename a member of the expert team; their ratings stay.

params.name: The new name; it must differ from the others. A name already taken is an error.

removeExpert.help: Remove a member from the expert team, together with their ratings.

addRow.help: Append a main cause to the end of the cause tree. Returns id and identifier.

addSubRow.help: Create a sub-cause under a cause; it inherits its category. Returns id and identifier.

setRowField.help: Set fields of a cause: name, category, description, status. Only the fields given change. Only main causes carry a category; for a sub-cause only the empty category is allowed.

params.name: Optional: the short name.
params.category: Optional: man, machine, environment, material, measurement, method or empty.
params.status: Optional: open, testing, confirmed or rejected.

removeRow.help: Delete a cause together with its sub-causes. Links from experiments are removed.

duplicateRow.help: Copy a cause together with its sub-causes and ratings; the copy stands right behind it. Returns the id of the copy.

moveRowBefore.help: Move a cause together with its sub-causes before another; it takes its parent. Without a target it goes behind the last sibling. A target inside the moved subtree is an error.

params.targetRowId: The cause before which it goes; null puts it at the end.

setRating.help: Set the rating of a cause by a member, from 0 (unlikely) to 9 (very likely). Mean and Pareto follow.

params.value: Integer from 0 to 9; null deletes the rating.

setCategoryLabels.help: Give the six categories names of their own, for example for 6P instead of 6M. Categories not mentioned keep their name.

params.labels: New name per category: man, machine, environment, material, measurement, method. Empty restores the default name; two categories must not have the same name.

setFilter.help: Show only the causes of one category, or all.

params.category: all or a category: man, machine, environment, material, measurement, method.

setParetoSource.help: Show the current ratings or those of a snapshot in the Pareto chart.

params.snapshotId: A snapshot; null shows the current state.

saveSnapshot.help: Save the current state of problem statement, expert team and cause tree as a snapshot.

params.name: The name; empty gives “Snapshot” with today’s date.

loadSnapshot.help: Restore a snapshot: problem statement, expert team and cause tree are replaced. Links from experiments to causes the snapshot does not know are removed.

compareSnapshot.help: Compare the current state with a snapshot. The table marks new and changed causes; the return value names new, removed and changed causes with old and new mean.

closeCompare.help: End the comparison with a snapshot.

addExperiment.help: Create an experiment that checks causes. Returns the id.

setExperimentField.help: Set fields of an experiment: title, description, responsible, status, start, end, cost in euros or effort in hours. Only the fields given change.

params.title: Optional: the title.
params.status: Optional: planned, running, done or cancelled.
params.startDate: Optional: start as YYYY-MM-DD or empty.
params.endDate: Optional: end as YYYY-MM-DD or empty.
params.costMoney: Optional: cost in euros, not negative; null deletes.
params.costHours: Optional: effort in hours, not negative; null deletes.

params.targetExperimentId: The experiment before which it goes; null puts it at the end.

setExperimentHypotheses.help: Define which causes an experiment checks.

params.hypothesisIds: The identifier of each cause, such as H-001; an empty list releases all.

setCauseExperiments.help: Define which experiments check a cause; the links of all experiments are set or released accordingly.

params.stableId: The identifier of the cause, such as H-001.
params.experimentIds: The ids of the experiments; an empty list releases all.

addFact.help: Create a fact: a verified observation that supports the search for causes. Returns the id.

setFactField.help: Set fields of a fact: name, description, date or owner. Only the fields given change.

params.name: Optional: the name.
params.date: Optional: the date as YYYY-MM-DD or empty.

params.targetFactId: The fact before which it goes; null puts it at the end.

addImage.help: Put an image into one of the two galleries. Returns the id.

params.scope: The gallery: inScope (typical defect images) or outScope (explicitly excluded).
params.dataUrl: The image as a data URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP).
params.caption: The caption; empty is allowed.

removeImage.help: Delete an image from a gallery.

params.id: The id of the image in this gallery.

setImageCaption.help: Set the caption of an image.

params.id: The id of the image in this gallery.
params.caption: The new caption; empty deletes it.

tab.help: The tab shown: problem, hypotheses, experiments or facts. A view only; it is not saved.

collapsed.help: The ids of the collapsed causes; their sub-causes are hidden. A view only; it is not saved.

filter.help: Which category the table shows: all or man, machine, environment, material, measurement, method. A view only; it changes no data.

compareSnapId.help: The snapshot the table is compared with; null without comparison. If it points to a deleted snapshot, null applies.

paretoSnapId.help: The snapshot whose ratings the Pareto chart shows; null for the current state. If it points to a deleted snapshot, null applies.

trendVisible.help: Whether the trend of the scores over the snapshots is shown. A view only.

trendEdits.help: The editor settings of the trend chart, such as which series are hidden. A view only; it is not saved.

lightbox.help: The image shown enlarged (gallery and id); null when none is open. A view only.

dragPreview.help: The preview while dragging a row: where it would land. A view only; it is not saved.

man.help: Custom name of the category Man; empty restores the default name.

machine.help: Custom name of the category Machine; empty restores the default name.

environment.help: Custom name of the category Environment; empty restores the default name.

material.help: Custom name of the category Material; empty restores the default name.

measurement.help: Custom name of the category Measurement; empty restores the default name.

method.help: Custom name of the category Method; empty restores the default name.

experimentIds.help: The experiments that contribute to checking this cause.

topN.help: How many of the highest-rated causes the tile shows at most.

showLegend.help: Shows the legend of categories and statuses below the bars.

ParetoItem.name: The name of the cause without surrounding spaces; if it is empty, the identifier.
ParetoItem.category: The effective category: its own or that of the main cause; empty without either.
ParetoItem.score: The mean of the ratings given, from 0 to 9.
